headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to focus on racial equity and support for underserved communities.
what_it_does: This executive order, signed by President Biden, sets a goal for the federal government to advance racial equity and support communities that have been underserved. No summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires of federal agencies are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies are directed to work toward racial equity and support for underserved communities, though the exact requirements are not given in the source.

who_it_affects.group: Members of racial groups and communities considered underserved
who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at how the federal government serves these communities, but the specific effects are not described in the source.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2021; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
